sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Demonstration Model is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good day, mercenary. You arrived just in time. Some of my partners would like us to test the weapons before purchasing them. They require a demonstration. Take 7.62x51 assault rifles and designated marksman rifles and head to Reserve. There has been some suspicious activity reported there recently... Let us combine business with pleasure."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must reach Loyalty Level 3 with Peacekeeper to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate any 15 targets with headshots with 7.62x51 assault rifles or DMRs on Reserve

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.75
- 1,900 Dollars
  - 1,995 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 2,185 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
"I have already been informed of how you performed. The order from my partners has been confirmed."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you have to kill any 15 enemies with headshots using a 7.62x51mm NATO assault rifle or designated marksman rifle. You can use any of the following:
- DS Arms SA58 7.62x51 assault rifle
- Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle
- FN SCAR-H 7.62x51 assault rifle
- FN SCAR-H X-17 7.62x51 assault rifle
- HK G28 7.62x51 marksman rifle
- Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle
- Kel-Tec RFB 7.62x51 rifle
- Knight's Armament Company SR-25 7.62x51 marksman rifle
- Remington R11 RSASS 7.62x51 marksman rifle
- Springfield Armory M1A 7.62x51 rifle
